### Analysis

- Read annotation

```{r}

annotation_gtf <- "/export2/home/koustav/Genomes/ENSEMBL_hg38/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.104.chr_patch_hapl_scaff.gtf"
annotation_ranges <- import.gff2(annotation_gtf)
annotation_gene_ranges <- annotation_ranges[annotation_ranges$type == "gene"]

```

- Compute TPMs and filter data

```{r}

# feature_ranges_with_repeats <- significant_de_event_list$repeat_containing_ranges
counts_matrix <- genic_count_list$counts 
tpm_matrix <- counts_matrix / (width(annotation_gene_ranges[match(rownames(counts_matrix), annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]) / 1e3)
tpm_matrix <- t(t(tpm_matrix) / (colSums(tpm_matrix) / 1e6))


coldata_df <- genic_count_list$coldata
coldata_df$expr <- tpm_matrix[annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id[annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name == "ERAP2" & !is.na(annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name)],
    coldata_df$column_id]
coldata_df$tissue_group <- "spinal_cord"
coldata_df$tissue_group[coldata_df$tissue %in% c("Cortex_Motor", "Cortex", "Cerebellum")] <- "brain"

subset_matrix <- as.data.frame(counts_matrix[rownames(counts_matrix) %in% 
    annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id[annotation_gene_ranges$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"],])
keep_matrix <- subset_matrix[(rowSums(subset_matrix == 0) / ncol(subset_matrix)) < 0.10,]


```

- Summarise data to patient level

```{r}


coldata_df$matrix_row <- match(coldata_df$column_id, colnames(keep_matrix))

cols_split_by_patient <- split(coldata_df, paste(coldata_df$subject_id, coldata_df$tissue_group))

patient_matrix <- do.call(cbind, lapply(cols_split_by_patient, function(x){
    if(nrow(x) == 1){
        return(keep_matrix[,x$matrix_row])
    }
    return(rowMeans(keep_matrix[,x$matrix_row]))
}))
# rownames(patient_matrix) <- annotation_ranges$gene_name[match(rownames(patient_matrix), annotation_ranges$gene_id)]


patient_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cols_split_by_patient, function(temp_df){
    return_df <- unique(temp_df[,!(colnames(temp_df) %in% 
        c("X", "sample_name", "alignment_file", "alignment_file_dir",
          "isPairedEnd", "strand_specificity", "samplesheet_path", 
          "column_id", "sample_id", "mutation", "site_of_motor_onset",
          "instrument", "rin", "expr", "tissue", "matrix_row"))])
    if(nrow(return_df) > 1){
        # message(paste(unique(return_df$subject_id), unique(return_df$tissue)))
        if("N/A" %in% return_df$mnd_with_ftd & "Yes" %in% return_df$mnd_with_ftd){
            return_df <- return_df[return_df$mnd_with_ftd == "Yes",]
        }else if("N/A" %in% return_df$mnd_with_ftd & "No" %in% return_df$mnd_with_ftd){
            return_df <- return_df[return_df$mnd_with_ftd == "No",]
        }else{
            stop(paste(return_df$subject_id, return_df$tissue))
        }
        # message(nrow(return_df))
    }
    return_df$expr <- mean(temp_df$expr)
    return_df$column_id <- paste(return_df$subject_id, return_df$tissue_group)
    return(return_df)
}))
patient_df$age_at_death[patient_df$age_at_death == "90 or Older"] <- "90"
patient_df$age_at_death <- as.numeric(patient_df$age_at_death)
patient_df$age_at_onset <- as.numeric(patient_df$age_at_symptom_onset)
patient_df$disease_duration_in_months <- as.numeric(patient_df$disease_duration_in_months)
patient_df$disease_duration <- as.numeric(patient_df$disease_duration_in_months)
```

- Perform CemiTool analysis with the subset of patients who had disease duration less than 12 months

```{r}


tissue_level_connectivity_list <- lapply(unique(patient_df$tissue_group), function(a_tissue){
    current_patients_df <- patient_df[patient_df$tissue_group == a_tissue &
        # patient_df$disease_duration_in_months <= 12 & 
        !is.na(patient_df$disease_duration_in_months),]
        message(nrow(current_patients_df))
    # als_patient_expr_quantiles <- quantile(current_patients_df$expr[current_patients_df$condition != "ctrl"], c(0.9))
    anno_df <- current_patients_df
    # [
    #     current_patients_df$disease_duration_in_months <= 12 & 
    #     !is.na(current_patients_df$disease_duration_in_months) &
    #     current_patients_df$expr > als_patient_expr_quantiles,]
    keep_matrix_df <- as.data.frame(patient_matrix[,anno_df$column_id])
    cem <- cemitool(keep_matrix_df, annot = anno_df, 
        apply_vst = T, 
        sample_name_column = "column_id", class_column = "condition")
    return(cem)
})
names(tissue_level_connectivity_list) <- unique(patient_df$tissue_group)
```

- Perform gene set enrichment for each module

```{r}

unloadNamespace("enrichR")
require("enrichR")

module_df <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "04-postmortem-WGCNA-gene-modules.rds"))
gene_split <- split(module_df, module_df$modules)

dbs <- "GO_Biological_Process_2023"
groups <- names(gene_split)
module_enrichment_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(a_group){
    a_temp_df <- gene_split[[a_group]]
        db_df_list <- lapply(dbs, function(a_database){
            message(paste(a_database, a_group))
            current_genes <- a_temp_df$gene_name[a_temp_df$modules == a_group]
            an_enrichment_df <- enrichr(current_genes,  a_database)[[1]]
            if(nrow(an_enrichment_df) == 0){
                return(NULL)
            }
            an_enrichment_df$num_gene <- length(current_genes)
            an_enrichment_df$db <- a_database
            Sys.sleep(5)
            return(an_enrichment_df)
        })
        db_df <- do.call(rbind, db_df_list)
    db_df$modules <- a_group
    return(db_df)
}))


module_enrichment_df$gene_ratio <- vapply(module_enrichment_df$Overlap, function(x){
    eval(parse(text = x))
},1)

write.csv(x = module_enrichment_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "09-02-gene-set-enrichment-analysis-of-coexpression-modules.csv"))
write.csv(x = module_enrichment_df[module_enrichment_df$P.value < 0.05,], file = file.path(output_dir, "09-02-significant-gene-set-enrichment-analysis-of-coexpression-modules.csv"))
```

- Plot gene set enrichment results

```{r}

require(patchwork)
require(cowplot)


    my_theme <- theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
        linetype = "dashed",
        size = 0.2))

module_enrichment_split <- split(module_enrichment_df, module_enrichment_df$modules)
module_enrichment_split <- module_enrichment_split[names(module_enrichment_split) != "Not.Correlated"]

plot_list <- lapply(module_enrichment_split, function(temp_df){
    message(unique(temp_df$modules))
    significant_df <- temp_df[temp_df$Adjusted.P.value < 0.05 & temp_df$gene_ratio > 0.1,]
    significant_df <- significant_df[order(significant_df$gene_ratio, decreasing = T),][1:10,]
    significant_df$label <- vapply(str_split(significant_df$Term, pattern = " "), function(x){
        paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = " ")
    },"1")

    significant_df$label <- factor(significant_df$label, levels = significant_df$label[order(significant_df$gene_ratio, decreasing = F)])
    ThePlot_1 <- ggplot(significant_df, aes(x = -log10(P.value), y = label))
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000", 
    #     width = 0.5, lwd = 0.5)
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + geom_point(fill = "#F4AC45", colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1), colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + scale_x_continuous("-log10 pvalue")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + scale_y_discrete("Enriched terms in each module")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + theme_bw()
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + ggtitle(unique(significant_df$modules))
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + my_theme
})

all_plots <- wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
save_plot(ncol = 3, nrow = 3, 
    base_width = 8, base_height = 5,
    file = file.path(plot_dir, "09-03-plot-gene-set-enrichment-of-modules.pdf"), plot = all_plots)

```

- Get the STRING network


```{r}

require("STRINGdb")
require("ggrepel")
source("11-postmortem-data-analysis/scripts/src/cemitools_network_plotting_functions.R")


string_db <- STRINGdb$new(version = "11.5", species = 9606, score_threshold = 200, input_directory = tmp_dir)
genes_from_modules_mapped_to_string_db <- string_db$map(module_df, "genes", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE)

interactions_df <- string_db$get_interactions(genes_from_modules_mapped_to_string_db$STRING_id)

cemi_interaction_df <- data.frame(
    gene1symbol = genes_from_modules_mapped_to_string_db[match(interactions_df$from, genes_from_modules_mapped_to_string_db$STRING_id),"genes"],
    gene2symbol = genes_from_modules_mapped_to_string_db[match(interactions_df$to, genes_from_modules_mapped_to_string_db$STRING_id),"genes"])

spinal_cord_object <- tissue_level_connectivity_list[["spinal_cord"]]

interactions_data(spinal_cord_object) <- cemi_interaction_df

interactions_list <- spinal_cord_object@interactions
modified_interactions_list <- lapply(interactions_list, function(x){
    igraph::V(x)$name <- annotation_ranges$gene_name[match(igraph::V(x)$name, annotation_ranges$gene_id)]
    x
})
spinal_cord_object@interactions <- modified_interactions_list

spinal_cord_object <- plot_interactions(spinal_cord_object, label_genes = c("ERAP2"))

plots <- show_plot(spinal_cord_object, "interaction")
pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "09-04-plot-interaction-data-for-modules.pdf"))
```
